what: A large heading drops from the top of the screen over 3s power1.out while its letters scramble into symbols (every .04s), then from .45s unscramble one by one starting from the first letter (2.1s). Once it has landed, a single last letter falls off the line (.7s power2.in) and lies tilted 16° on the floor line below. On phones the first letter of the last word falls

options.scramble: Symbol unscramble duration (seconds), default 2.1 — 0 means no mixing
options.fall: Fall duration of the last letter (sec), default .7
options.drop: Initial lift distance — times (title area height + title height), default 1
options.which: last (final letter) · first-of-last-word (first letter of the last word) · auto (default: first-of-last-word on phones)
options.[data-fx-part=floor]: Floor the fallen letters land on (optional — if empty, the bottom edge of the title + .4 times the letter height)

use:
Enter your title here
Placed in two lines

from.where: index.js hero intro (original HeroIntro: title y −(title + h1 height)→0 over 3s power1.out, letter cipher 2.1s (.7×3) · .45s · .04s, at 3s the last letter drops with getFallVars .7s power2.in)

note: Floor is inside the same parent’s [data-fx-part=floor] is looked up first, and if missing the parent’s next sibling is checked. Text width is pinned to its original width while mixing so lines don’t shake
